description: Exhaustive list of action types the policy must handle.

actions.description: Observe the current room. Always allowed regardless of state.
Move from current_room to an adjacent room. Requires the door's item (if any) in inventory. Blocked by cursed_idol unless eclipse.
Pick up an item present in current_room (i.e. item is in available_items).
Craft a new item from two items in inventory. Only valid combinations are (stick, rock) and (torch, oil). Order does not matter.
Use an item from inventory. Allowed when item is in inventory.
Decode the glyph at the Archive terminal. Only allowed in R2. Grants glyph_key with the computed integer id.
Teleport to a previously-unlocked, transitively reachable room via the wormhole pad. Only available in R6. Blocked by cursed_idol unless eclipse.
Exit through the final door (R5 to R7). Requires lit_torch and glyph_key (correct id) in inventory, player in R5, and no active curse.
